clue.text: Unusually fine cable I find is useful

indicators.note: done unusually, the letters of these words fall into a different order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone praising a fine cable they have found handy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusually' shuffles FINE CABLE I; 'find is' only links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something beneficial does good, so it is helpful in the same way as anything useful.

clue.text: Brian and Andrew but not Ian have a drink

indicators.note: but not tells us to remove one name's letters from the other name

parts.note: taken as written, its letters scattered through Brian
Andy is the usual short form of the name Andrew

explanation.surface: Three friends, one of whom stays away, going for a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking I, A and N out of BRIAN leaves BR. The held text reads 'Ivan', a misreading of 'Ian': Brian has no V to remove.
explanation.definitionFit: Brandy is a spirit distilled from wine, a common after-dinner tipple.

clue.text: Remarkably a plan first mooted involved the use of pertroleum jelly

indicators.note: remarkably here means in a striking new arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: first picks out the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A plan floated early on to use petroleum jelly.
explanation.definitionFit: Napalm is a jellied petrol mixture used in incendiary weapons.

clue.text: Become aware of the action of a pickpocket?

definitions.text: Become aware of the action of a pickpocket?

parts.words: Become aware of the action of a pickpocket?
parts.note: read literally, a victim senses the thief's nip at the pocket; the idiom means to begin suffering money troubles

explanation.surface: Noticing a thief lifting your wallet.
explanation.walkthrough: A pickpocket 'pinches' (steals), so sensing it is feeling that pinch; the real phrase means starting to suffer from a shortage of money.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to start to suffer hardship, especially from lack of money, matching the pinched pocket.

clue.text: Scolded youngster without money

indicators.note: without means one piece is dropped from the other

parts.note: a child is a youngster
L stands for pound (libra), a sum of money

explanation.surface: A child told off for having no cash.
explanation.walkthrough: L for pound comes from the Latin libra; removing it from CHILD leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Chid is an old past tense of chide, to rebuke or tell off.

clue.text: The saint is converted by the opposition

indicators.note: converted means changed in form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A saint being won over by the other side.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'is' belongs to the indicator; the first goes into the fodder THE SAINT IS.
explanation.definitionFit: An antithesis is the direct contrary, a contrast or opposition between ideas.

clue.text: Applied with experience

definitions.meaning: accustomed, as in being ... to something

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: employed for a purpose, and accustomed through practice.

clue.text: Not a universal remedy

parts.note: a cure-all treats everything; the opposite is a medicine aimed at one particular disease

explanation.surface: A warning that no cure-all exists.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine the noun names a drug targeted at a particular disease, as opposed to a panacea.

clue.text: Idlin'? Get around to be hard-working

indicators.note: around suggests the letters being turned about into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe giving no letter
taken as written

explanation.surface: A lazybones urged to stop lounging about and buckle down.
explanation.definitionFit: A diligent person is industrious and careful, putting in steady effort.

clue.text: Realise that it will increase in value

definitions.meaning: grow in worth, as property or shares do

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to recognise or understand and to rise in worth over time.

clue.text: Prevent the escape of a circus performer

definitions.meaning: close off tightly so nothing gets out
a performing animal that balances balls in the ring

explanation.definitionFit: To close tight so nothing leaks, and the flippered animal trained to do tricks in a circus.

clue.text: Amazingly how water was changed to wine?

definitions.text: how water was changed to wine?
definitions.meaning: at the wedding at Cana in the Gospel, Jesus turned water into wine as a miracle

explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means astonishingly, and it describes the supernatural way the wedding-feast water turned to wine.

clue.text: Weaken the Italian appearing in another duet

indicators.note: appearing in puts one piece inside the other
another version of the word means its letters rearranged

parts.note: il is the Italian word for the

explanation.surface: An Italian singer whose duet takes the edge off a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' shuffles DUET to DUTE; 'appearing in' slips the Italian article inside. The surface's musical duet is a red herring.
explanation.definitionFit: To dilute is to thin out, reducing strength by adding water.

clue.text: Not right in making an intense effort adding colour

indicators.note: not here means the next thing named is absent from the word

parts.note: straining means trying very hard

explanation.surface: Someone struggling hard to get something done.
explanation.definitionFit: Staining is applying a dye or tint, so it adds colour to wood or cloth.

clue.text: Lawless drunk associate

definitions.meaning: the word paired with drunk in the charge of being drunk and

explanation.walkthrough: 'Drunk and disorderly' is a standard British police charge, so the answer is drunk's partner in that phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: It means unruly or riotous, and it is the word that partners drunk in that common charge.

clue.text: Coolness needed on reflection

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both slow, calm unhurriedness and careful consideration of a matter.

clue.text: Colourful bands

parts.note: suggests flamboyant musical groups, but means the coloured stripes light splits into

explanation.definitionFit: White light passed through a prism separates into the stripes of a rainbow, from red to violet.

clue.text: Skilled performer endlessly in charge

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: an artiste is a professional entertainer

explanation.surface: A capable entertainer always running the show.
explanation.definitionFit: Artistic means having creative talent and skill in the arts.

clue.text: Stingy clergyman has about 999 debts

indicators.note: about means the clergyman word wraps around the number

parts.note: a parson is a parish priest
in Roman numerals 999 can be written IM, one less than a thousand
IOUs are written promises to pay, so debts

explanation.surface: A mean vicar with a pile of unpaid bills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link; IM is a loose Roman numeral for 999 (1000 minus 1).
explanation.definitionFit: Parsimonious describes extreme reluctance to spend money, meanness.

clue.text: Assumed I could have included a practitioner

indicators.note: these words have the answer included within them, running across the word breaks

explanation.surface: Someone supposing they could have added a doctor to the list.
explanation.definitionFit: Medico is informal for a doctor, a medical practitioner.

clue.text: Bets to receive on board

indicators.note: on board means inside a ship, so one piece goes within the steamship letters

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, the vessel you are on board
to take is to receive

explanation.surface: Gamblers' wagers collected on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; 'on board' is the stock signal for putting letters inside SS.
explanation.definitionFit: Stakes are sums of money wagered, as on a horse race.

clue.text: Agree to occupy the same place at the same time

definitions.text: occupy the same place at the same time

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to correspond or tally, and to happen or be located together simultaneously.

clue.text: Brief time of importance

explanation.definitionFit: It means an instant, and significance, as in a matter of great weight.

clue.text: Record and disc make up the design

parts.note: a log is a written record, like a ship's log
O is a round shape, so a disc

explanation.surface: A ship's record and a CD forming a pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: A logo is an emblem, a design identifying a company or brand.

clue.text: Pity Boas married her!

definitions.meaning: an old word for compassion or sorrow
in the Old Testament Boaz (here Boas) weds the Moabite widow

explanation.definitionFit: It is an archaic word for compassion, and the biblical widow who married Boaz in the book bearing her name.

clue.text: Witchcraft?

parts.note: read as craft (vehicle) of a witch, it means what a witch flies on

explanation.definitionFit: Witches in folklore fly on a long-handled sweeping brush, their aircraft.

clue.text: Animals used in cosmic experiments

indicators.note: the letters used in these words sit inside them, spanning the gap

explanation.surface: Creatures sent up for space experiments.
explanation.definitionFit: Mice are small rodents, often used in laboratory research.

clue.text: Having the same meaning as 'mousy, sonny discovered

indicators.note: discovered suggests the letters are uncovered in a fresh arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A timid little boy found out.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonymous words mean the same, like big and large.
